title: Web3 Event Check-In With Proof of Attendance
tagline: Simple Web3 Based Check-In App using World Coin and Javascript
description: This is my first solidity project solo and was quite the challenge. I used camiinthisthang's javascript stack/template to get the wallet integration with the front end but ran out of time to deploy the contract and utilize EPNS like I had wanted to. The majority of the time was spent on working on smart contract login and its implementation with the front end which took a large chunk of time as I am not a web dev.
how_its_made: This project uses World Coin, Metamask, RainbowKit + wagmi + Next.js  + TailwindCSS. I am a solo developer and did not have the benefit of having a team so I made my goal to keep it as simple as possible while also making it functional. I learned a lot and am very appreciate to the mentors who assisted me tremendously on front-end intergration with the blockchain.
